NVIDIA’s Education Services team is hiring a Senior Technical Trainer and Content Developer to build and teach our AI data center curriculum. Our courses cover mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems; power and cooling; fiber cabling; equipment installation; and the coordination required to bring these systems together. * Develop curriculum around AI data center power and cooling requirements, including calculations for electrical loads, rack power density, cooling capacity, and liquid-cooling flow requirements. You’ll help learners understand how these requirements influence facility readiness, equipment placement, installation sequencing, and deployment decisions.
* Bring experience leading deployment teams in the field and coordinating work across disciplines.
